toegepas.rede_vinder: 'daarmee' points back across a quotation and is vague for Grade 4; naming the message makes the reference clear without adding content.
toegepas.fout: 'daarmee' reaches back across the quoted message to 'n boodskap', a stumble for a Grade 4 reader.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the message makes the reference clear, adds no content, leaves the protected 'n klein insek' intact, and the following 'dit' still points to the message.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'self' before the object reads as a stray word (neither 'of her own accord' nor 'selfs'); dropping it is natural and leaves what happens in the story unchanged.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Removes 'self' from the protected wording 'Sy los self haar been', which carries the story's point that the hyena lets go of the bone herself, unlike Aesop's dog.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: sny nag na nag stukke van hom af
laat_vaar_vorige.na: sny nag na nag stukke van die Maan af
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The subject is the Son, so 'van hom af' can read as the Sun cutting pieces off itself.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: In a paragraph about the Moon, 'van hom af' with the Sun as subject reads naturally as the Moon, and the proposal puts 'die Maan' in three sentences running.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: om hom te los ter wille van sy kinders
laat_vaar_vorige.na: om hom ter wille van sy kinders te los
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: In standard Afrikaans the infinitive 'te los' stands at the end of the clause.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Placing 'ter wille van sy kinders' after the infinitive is normal Afrikaans and keeps the story's rhythm; the proposal is a lateral reorder.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: dat niemand na hom kan kyk nie
laat_vaar_vorige.na: dat niemand meer na hom kan kyk nie
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Past 'het begin skyn' followed by present 'kan' jars; 'meer' keeps the still-true present reading while linking it to the moment he started shining.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Present 'kan' deliberately carries the still-true outcome, as 'vandag nog' does in the next lines, while 'meer' adds a claim that people could look at him before.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Die haas krap na die Maan se gesig
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Die haas krap die Maan in die gesig
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'krap na' suggests an attempt that may miss, which sits oddly with marks that remain; 'iemand in die gesig krap' is the idiomatic form and keeps what happens in the story.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The proposal removes the protected wording 'krap na die Maan se gesig' and brings in the listed forbidden form 'krap die Maan in die gesig', which changes the hare's action in the story as decided in an earlier round.
